issue: #342 — change the elicitation TARGET to beat the more-is-better prior-echo

arms.comparative_ledger: show both + forced signed mechanism ledger (positive AND negative/backfire pathways) before verdict — the CONSERVATIVE fix (keeps the comparison that preserves signal)
arms.per_arm_behavioral: score each version in ISOLATION as audience responsiveness; winner=higher mean; tracks a TIE rate = signal-collapse (the founder's concern: isolation re-breaks what comparative fixed)

discriminator: less-won subset accuracy (4 cases where the simpler option won)
guardrail: more-won subset accuracy must NOT regress vs baseline (catches over-correction / re-collapse)
power_note: n=10 (4 less-won, 4 more-won, 2 ambiguous) detects only LARGE effects; this is a FILTER not a confirmation. Confirmation needs ~40-60 fresh less-won cases + cross-model replication.

registered_predictions.comparative_ledger: HYPOTHESIS: less-won improves to >=3/4 WITHOUT more-won dropping below 3/4
registered_predictions.per_arm_behavioral: UNCERTAIN — risk of signal collapse (high tie_rate) and/or no gain; if tie_rate is high it CONFIRMS the founder's concern that isolation re-collapses the signal
registered_predictions.placebo_leaner: scores HIGH on less-won but LOW on more-won (sacrifices them) — the thumb profile

decision_rule.REAL_FIX: an arm passes only if less_won>=3/4 AND more_won>=3/4 AND it does NOT match the placebo's profile (placebo trades more-won for less-won). A real fix lifts less-won while KEEPING more-won.
decision_rule.THUMB: less-won up but more-won down (like placebo) -> rejected as a pro-simpler thumb, not reasoning
decision_rule.COLLAPSE: per_arm tie_rate high / no gain -> isolation re-breaks the signal (founder's concern validated); keep comparison, prefer the ledger arm
decision_rule.NULL: no arm clears the bar -> report honestly; method change does not fix it at the forecaster level; consider the full persona-panel behavioral sim next

next_if_pass: lock the winning arm, replicate on a 2nd model (Groq), then confirm on a fresh held-out counter-intuitive set
